steps.title: Gather equipment and consumables
steps.instruction: Collect all required hardware and labware: Opentrons OT‑2 robot, OT‑2 Run App (version 3.15.0 or later), Swift accel‑amplicon‑plus‑egfr‑pathway‑panel kit, Opentrons Thermocycler Module, Opentrons Temperature Module with Aluminum Block Set, Opentrons Magnetic Module, Opentrons P20 single‑channel pipette (or P50 single‑channel pipette), Opentrons P300 multi‑channel pipette, Opentrons tips, NEST 96‑well PCR plate, NEST 12‑well reservoir (15 mL), and DNA samples resuspended in 10 µL Low EDTA TE.

steps.title: Set module temperatures
steps.instruction: Pre‑cool the Temperature Module to 4 °C and pre‑heat the Thermocycler block to 98 °C; also pre‑heat the Thermocycler lid (temperature as indicated by the protocol).

steps.title: Define sample number
steps.instruction: In the protocol customisation fields, specify the number of samples you will process (choose any integer from 1 up to 24).

steps.title: Download the OT‑2 protocol
steps.instruction: Download the Accel‑Amplicon Plus EGFR Pathway Panel protocol file from the Opentrons website.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the OT‑2 Run App, upload the downloaded protocol, and confirm that the app settings pre‑cool the Temperature Module to 4 °C and pre‑heat the Thermocycler as described.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place all labware on the OT‑2 deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, run the calibration routine for the selected pipette (P20, P50, or P300) and for each piece of labware, employing the calibration tips supplied.

steps.title: Start the automated run
steps.instruction: Press the “Run” button in the OT App to begin the protocol.

steps.title: Add reagents on light cue
steps.instruction: When the deck lights momentarily go off, pause the run and manually add the required reagents to the indicated positions on the OT‑2 deck, then resume the protocol.
